title: Report publication bundle
responsibility: Stages a finalized report’s exports and evidence into a locally hashed Pages-ready bundle.

inputs.name: reportPublication.repository
inputs.description: Repository used to read the report and resolve report/store directories.

outputs.name: reportPublication
outputs.description: Promise resolving to report id, optional revision, temporary staging directory, files with bytes/MIME/hash and a digest of their ordered path/hash list. Writes exports, unique evidence files and response-header rules to staging; this helper does not deploy.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects expired or nonfinalized reports, absent exports, missing evidence, unexpected export names, evidence filenames that do not match content hashes, or any asset above 25 MiB. Registered-file and filesystem errors propagate.
